t_advice_summary_textbox.text: THE COLOURS WILL CHANGE BUT ALTERNATE BETWEEN THEM; IF TYOU PICKED GREEN LAST TIME, PICK THE OTHER COLOUR OPTION NEXT TIME. THIS WILL GET YOU A HIGHER SCORE. THIS APPLIES EVERY 2 TO 3 ROUNDS.

vb_textbox.text: I could not identify a pattern and believe the numbers are random. Try to click S or K as soon as the blue box appears and click several times otherwise you will be marked as too slow.  When the grey cross appears on the screen, immediately start pressing your space key and press it a few times to be deemed as fast enough to collect mushrooms.
